forcedtoprovisional:
- All forums.envato.com findings (F-P01 through F-P11) forced to provisional because the forum returns HTTP 403 on all direct fetch attempts. Envato officially closed forums on August 15, 2025. Content recovered exclusively from Google search snippets.
- F-P12 (Sajjad Hussain, Medium) forced to provisional because page returned HTTP 410 (gone/removed); content from search snippet only.
degradedtocouldnotverify:
- F-X07, F-X08, F-X09: Forum quotes embedded within WPBay article degraded to Part 4 as secondary retelling. Original forum sources return 403. The WPBay article attributions ("one Power Elite author shared on forums," "said John from Kreatura," "wrote one veteran user on the forums") could not be independently verified at original source.
- F-X06: Info Inlet Medium article degraded to Part 4 — author is not a seller (industry analyst/observer). Developer friend's rejection is hearsay.
- F-X10: WPINDIGO article degraded — author (Ivor) not confirmed as Envato seller. Disclaimer references "stories shared by other web developers" and no seller-specific evidence (no earnings data, no submission history, no dashboard references).
- F-X19: Mdabusuzan.bd degraded — primarily buyer complaint with tangential seller reference ("my buyers"). Insufficient evidence of first-person seller experience.
- F-X20: Terry degraded — primarily buyer perspective with advisory reference to sellers.
urlnotfixable_degradations: - None. All URLs in Part 1 and Part 2 resolve to specific pages or threads.
multispeaker_splits:
- F-P02 and F-P03: Same thread (forums.envato.com/t/steady-decline-in-sales-on-envato-elements/520719), different pages (main thread vs. page 2), different speakers. Split into separate findings.
- F-P06 and F-P07: Same thread (forums.envato.com/t/elements-earning-stats-broken/518529), different pages (main vs. page 5), different speakers. Split into separate findings.
- F-01/F-02/F-03 and F-04: Same source URL (WPBay article), but F-01/F-02/F-03 = CodeRevolution (article author), F-04 = Tomasz Leder (commenter). Different speakers, same URL. Additionally, F-01/F-02/F-03 are same speaker but different reported dimensions (revenue outcome, frustration, workaround) per the "one seller × one reported experience" unit of observation.
- F-05: Different URL from F-01/F-02/F-03 (WPBay forum closure article vs. main article) but same speaker (CodeRevolution). Separate finding on different source URL with different topic (forum closure).

source_type_ambiguities:
- F-06, F-07, F-08, F-09 (Trustpilot): source_type set to `unknown` per protocol rule (Trustpilot not in the 18-value enum). Trustpilot is a review platform; `buyer_review` was considered but these are seller reviews, not buyer reviews, and the platform is explicitly listed as requiring `unknown`.
- F-P01 through F-P11 (Envato forums): source_type set to `seller_forum`. Envato's community forums were a general community forum, not exclusively a seller forum, but the specific threads captured are from seller discussions and the speakers self-identify as authors/sellers.
- F-P12 (Medium): source_type set to `blog`. Medium functions as both a blogging platform and an article platform; `blog` used because the piece is a personal experience post, not journalistic article.
coverage_gaps:
- Reddit: Complete gap. Zero seller-voice content found on r/envato, r/graphic_design, or broader Reddit for the time window. r/envato appears to be an extremely small/inactive subreddit. Envato seller discussion historically occurred on forums.envato.com, which closed August 15, 2025. Migration of seller discussion to Reddit did not materially occur.
- YouTube: Complete gap. No seller-voice video content found for the time window.
- Substack: Complete gap. No Envato seller content found.
- Indie Hackers: Complete gap for in-window period. Relevant posts exist from 2024 but fall outside window.
- AudioJungle / music sellers: No in-window seller voice found. One relevant thread (F-X17) is pre-window.
- VideoHive / stock video sellers: No seller voice found at any date.
- PhotoDune / stock photo sellers: No seller voice found at any date.
- Envato Elements-specific earnings data: No specific dollar figures found in verified or provisional findings within window. The $30 decline in F-P03 is the only in-window figure.
- Geographic diversity: Limited. Confirmed locations: Italy (F-06), Morocco (F-07). Inferred from product types: PrestaShop plugins (F-04) suggests European seller. Most forum posters have no location data in search snippets.
decomposition_issues:
- SD-04/SD-05 (Reddit): Complete null result despite extensive query decomposition (14+ queries). The decomposition was reasonable but the underlying data source is absent.
- SD-10 (YouTube): Complete null result. Decomposition was reasonable; no content exists.
- The Envato forum closure on August 15, 2025 substantially reduced available seller discussion for the second half of the time window. Post-closure, seller voice appears primarily on competing marketplace blogs (WPBay), Trustpilot reviews, and Medium — all of which have lower volume than the former forums.
- The WPBay blog (https://wpbay.com/) provided the richest seller-voice content but carries systematic bias as a competing marketplace. Three of nine Part 1 findings (F-01, F-02, F-03) and one of nine (F-05) come from the same speaker (CodeRevolution/Szabi, WPBay founder). This concentration reflects the post-forum-closure landscape rather than research bias.
- Envato's author application closure (Theme, Code, Photo, Audio, Graphics categories not planned for reopening; only Video reopening mid-April 2026) is confirmed via official Envato help page but represents platform policy, not seller voice, and is therefore excluded as a finding.
